messages:
sam: Heads up — CI started failing consistently on the audit-event validator after the RBAC actor wrapping change. Failing tests are the golden fixture rewrap checks for KMS-enveloped events.

maria: ugh, I saw that earlier. repro logs?

sam: Pasted the failing assertion: ```assert event.actor_id == golden.actor_id  # got wrapped:key:abcd vs user:alice``` CI output attached (snippet).

jess: That looks like the serializer now adds a keystore envelope prefix for sys-actors. Golden fixtures still expect raw actor id. Did we update the golden generation step when we landed the RBAC change?

sam: I don't think so. The feature landed without rotating the goldens. Pipeline just started sampling more envelope-encoded events (sampling config changed in dedicated run).

dalton: Infra-bot re-run shows the failing matrix only on python-3.10 / kms-integration job, passes elsewhere. Might be timing/sampling. Infra-bot: <@infra-bot> rerun job #4234 scheduled. :gear:

maria: If it's sampling-dependent, we should avoid brittle equality in the validator. Suggest canonicalize_actor(event) before compare and add an accept list for envelope variants.

jess: Agreed. Quick fix: update validator to normalize actor IDs (strip envelope prefix) and add a migration to rotate goldens for the new KMS envelope policy. But we need to preserve customer-facing audit shape — can't silently drop envelope metadata.

sam: Plan: (1) normalization in CI-only comparator to reduce false negatives, (2) regen golden fixtures with rewrap tool, (3) add an explicit schema field to indicate envelope metadata so validator asserts presence not exact string. Anyone want to own?

dalton: I can own the regen + PR to goldens. Will run rewrap tool with deterministic seed. Command I'll use: ```./tools/rewrap-goldens --kms-policy=envelope-v2 --seed=20240301``` and push to branch.

maria: I'll update the validator comparator and add test coverage for both pre- and post-envelope variants. Also add note in infra docs about sampling config so future CI matrix changes don't surprise us.

jess: I'll open a low-priority incident ticket to track customer impact review and confirm no exported audit events to S3 were mutated in prod.

infra-bot: CI rerun started for job #4234 at 1734568050.

sam: Thanks. After regen + comparator change, let's watch CI for 24h and then escalate if any remaining flake. If anyone hits more fails, ping me and I'll revert the RBAC actor wrap commit temporarily.

dalton: PR #4582 created with goldens regen, CI green locally. Link: https://git.internal/r/4582

maria: Validator comparator PR #4583 created, adding normalization + tests. Running full CI.

jess: Notifying security-compliance to review goldens regen for customer-facing audit compatibility. /cc @security-compliance

sam: Good work team. Follow-up items: add an acceptance test that runs rewrap tool against a small sample and asserts schema-invariants (actor metadata present, envelope version field exists). I'll own that ticket.

maria: Sounds good. Closing the thread for now — will reopen if CI shows regressions. :thumbsup:
